_doc: Production gates for anime_ekaya's daily build (CoS, 2026-09-06). The daily-build prompt reads this file FIRST and builds only what is open. Flip a gate only with the named evidence; record who/when/why in `note`. Same mechanism as nuvarel's build-gates.json.

carousel_video_slides.note: UPDATE (Group CTO, 2026-09-06): code shipped and unit-tested -- scripts/publish_due_posts.py's create_item_container() now accepts a `{"type": "video", "src": "..."}` slide entry (media_type: VIDEO + video_url + is_carousel_item: true), polled with the longer REEL_POLL_TIMEOUT_S bound; a bare-string slide entry (the entire pre-existing shape) is untouched and still means image. New tests: tests/test_publish_mixed_carousel.py -- all-image-carousel regression, mixed image+video child param shapes, video child gets the REEL timeout, is_ai_generated confirmed absent on every child (image or video) and present only on the CAROUSEL parent. Full test suite (57 tests) passes. STILL CLOSED: this session had no live IG_ACCESS_TOKEN/IG_USER_ID (those exist only as GitHub Actions secrets, not in any local session env) so item (3) of the original opening condition -- one real mixed video+image carousel actually publishing end-to-end against the live Graph API -- has NOT been verified. Opening the gate requires that live test. Verification procedure handed back to CoS/founder: (a) build one real short (3-5s) loop clip via scripts/render_reel.py (HTML->MP4 path, no --audio needed for a silent loop) and one or two real slide images, (b) queue a single test post JSON in accounts/anime_ekaya/content/queue/ with a mixed `slides` array (see docstring in publish_due_posts.py for the exact schema) and `needs_review: true` so it does NOT auto-publish, (c) once ready to actually test live, either clear needs_review and let the hourly publish-anime_ekaya.yml cron pick it up, or run `workflow_dispatch` on that workflow manually -- either way this puts a real, public, irreversible post on the live @anime_ekaya account, so treat the moment of clearing needs_review as the actual go/no-go decision, not this code change. (d) confirm in the Graph API response / IG app that the carousel shows an image slide alongside a playing video slide, then flip this gate's state to "open" and update accounts/anime_ekaya/docs/daily-build-agent-prompt.md's Step 0 + carousel-variety section to describe building one (reuse scripts/render_reel.py for the loop clip, per the module's own architecture note -- do not build a second HTML/Playwright renderer). Until flipped, every anime_ekaya (and any other account's) carousel must stay all-image -- do not hand-construct a video child in a real queued post before this gate opens.
